text: 4-PBA (4-phenylbutyric acid) acts as a chemical chaperone that alleviates endoplasmic reticulum stress, as indicated by reduced expression of general ER stress markers such as GRP78/BiP, CHOP, and ATF4, although the retrieved evidence (on VAP-dependent endosome–ER contacts and PI4P) does not address this claim and cannot support it.
